offering_description.value: Produces and sells salt, mainly highway deicing salt, plus consumer and industrial salt and specialty plant nutrition products. It mines salt and evaporates brine, and sells to governments, distributors, retailers and agricultural customers.

primary_products.value: highway deicing salt; consumer deicing and water conditioning salt; industrial and food-grade salt; specialty plant nutrition products

customer_segment.value: B2G: state, provincial and municipal road authorities buying deicing salt; B2B: distributors, retailers, agricultural and industrial customers; B2C: consumers buying packaged salt through retail

end_markets.value: highway deicing; consumer retail; agriculture; industrial; food processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: bulk and packaged salt and plant nutrition products, often under annual tender contracts

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines rock salt and evaporates brine, sold to road authorities, distributors and retailers; OEM / manufacturer: processes and packages salt and plant nutrients for consumer and agricultural use

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and the UK, with some sales elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: salt (highway, consumer, industrial) and plant nutrition minerals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: tender contracts with government road agencies and large customers; distributors / dealers: agricultural and industrial distributors; third-party retail: home improvement and grocery retailers selling packaged salt
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mine safety (MSHA), environmental rules, and food and fertilizer product regulation

notes: Business mix may have changed recently (e.g., Plant Nutrition portfolio and Great Salt Lake operations); details are approximate.
